title: Smoky Aubergine Tahini Dip
summary: A silky Middle Eastern-style aubergine dip with nutty tahini, lemon and garlic. It’s smoky, creamy and perfect as a snack with flatbread or vegetables.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Prick the aubergines all over, place them on a tray, and roast for 30 to 35 minutes until the skins are wrinkled and the flesh is very soft. For extra smokiness, finish them directly over a gas flame or under a hot grill until blackened in spots.
Leave the aubergines to cool slightly, then split them open and scoop the flesh into a bowl, discarding the skins.
Add the tahini, lemon juice, crushed garlic, olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, salt and water. Stir until smooth and creamy, adding a little more water if needed.
Taste and adjust with a little more lemon or salt if needed, then spoon into a bowl.
Finish with chopped parsley and a drizzle of olive oil before serving.
